questions.question: If all projection matrices are zero in this block, what should the output be?
options: Undefined because attention has zero scores
questions.explanation: Zero scores create uniform attention, but zero projections make sublayer contributions zero; both residual paths preserve \(x\).
optionFeedback: The attention branch vanishes but the skip connection remains. Substitute a zero branch into input plus branch.
Zero scores create uniform attention, but zero projections make sublayer contributions zero; both residual paths preserve \(x\).
